name: MegaWrestleFest

date.source: the recap's own dateline and the founding roster call's own advance schedule (msg_id BzvMEhEU1iAJ)

matches.note: Iron Man Tournament, 1st round; Taylor won a Victory Roll using a handful of tights.

Iron Man Tournament final, for the inaugural RSPCW World Heavyweight Championship; Petrow won a roll-up after Taylor mistimed his own "Hot Drop" finisher, following outside interference from the newly-crowned tag champions on both men.

notes: The federation's own debut supercard: thirteen matches crowning the inaugural TV, World Tag Team and World Heavyweight Championships in one afternoon. The served page's own verbatim text narrates all thirteen, the TV Championship match, the Iron Man Tournament's other rounds, the tag title cage match and several special-attraction bouts among them. The card closes with a heel stable, the Defiance Alliance, sweeping all three titles.
